patches.name: Bypass device compatibility check
patches.description: Bypasses the runtime and manifest checks for Gemini Intelligence Experience, unhides the widget from the system picker, and optionally adds a launcher shortcut.

options.description: Adds MAIN/LAUNCHER intent-filter to LlmWidgetConfigActivity so the configurator can also be opened from the app drawer.

patches.name: Redirect services to GmsCore
patches.description: Redirects Google Play Services, Google account, GServices, Phenotype, and MobStore calls to microG/GmsCore and spoofs the original signing SHA-1 for non-root installations.

options.description: Package prefix of your microG/GmsCore installation (e.g., app.revanced, com.mgoogle, org.microg).
Returns the original Play Store certificate SHA-1 when computing X-Android-Cert headers.

patches.name: Skip prompt templates loading error
patches.description: Prevents SuggestedWidgetPromptsDataServiceImpl from failing with PERMISSION_DENIED so bundled offline prompt suggestions still load in the configurator carousel.
